prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: one Empire C02 CAPTURE OBJECTIVE status icon, genuine transparent RGBA game sprite. Image 1 is the exact source subject on a magenta contact-sheet backing; that magenta is NOT part of the object. Image 2 provides only the approved chunky matte outline style. Rebuild the complete source symbol for native 32-by-32-pixel use.
Subject: one squat two-tier circular sci-fi control pedestal with a broad round foot, tapering mechanical upper housing, warm-gray armor and dark slate recesses. Cyan rectangular inset panels and a restrained narrow amber band identify the hardware. In the top circular socket stands exactly ONE short faceted cyan crystal column, flat-topped with a simple pale facet outline. From its center rises ONE thin straight vertical cyan beacon beam. Keep the beam bounded, solid and crisp, with a squared end rather than a fade or halo. Keep a few solid cyan shard flecks to either side of the column, retaining the source's small symmetrical four-left/four-right accent arrangement without adding particles elsewhere. The main masses are the broad pedestal and the single upright crystal/beacon. Preserve this pedestal-and-column capture marker, not a flag, map pin, arrow or target reticle.
Style: broad flat matte cel-painted hardware, heavy near-black contours and clear thick interior separations. Warm gray and dark muted slate-blue housing with bounded cyan windows and crystal, one narrow amber band. One broad highlight and one shadow per part. Minimize small seams, fine bolts, scratches and texture. The beacon and flecks are solid shape accents; no external glow, transparent mist or bloom. Shorten the beam relative to the source only enough that both pedestal and beacon read together at 32 pixels; do not crop it off.
Composition: centered complete object in a square canvas, pedestal occupies roughly the lower two-thirds of the grouped symbol and crystal/beam the upper third. Overall icon about 86 percent canvas height, all edges and beam visible, clear transparent margin on every side. True transparent background, every outer row and column alpha zero. Absolutely no magenta backing, checkerboard painting, ground shadow, fog, haze, halo or stray pixels. No words, numbers, logos or watermark. Must composite unchanged on white, black and olive.
